title: No Comments, Just Sing Pal
style: post-punk rap, 92 BPM, spoken word hooks, baritone rap vocals, overdriven bass guitar, angular guitar stabs, tom-heavy live drums, cold analog synths, gang shouts, vinyl crackle, dry room reverb, tape saturation, sparse verses, sudden drops, call and response, quiet-loud dynamics, grimy urgency
lyrics:
[INTRO — sly electro-house + vinyl crackle, cameras + sub rumble]  
[Bass – low & sly]  
Reporters flashing… Corey stacking…  
[Fem Lead – seductive]  
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound  
If you got something real to say, don’t type it — lay it down  

[BABBLE BOTS – soft echo]  
Lay it down… lay it down…  
[High Singer – airy]  
Questions coming… don’t ignore…  
[Mid – smooth]  
But I sing it back… Songpal style!  

[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce meets sneaky bass]  
[Male Rap]  
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap  
Everybody tough behind the screen till the beat says “what you got?”  
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass attack  
You dropped two real words in the track and I felt that  

[Bass – over sliding bass]  
Reporters flashing left and right, cameras popping in my face,  
Questions flying fast and furious, filling up the space.  
Corey stacking every answer, not ignoring a single one,  
Microphones thrust forward – here it comes, the fun’s begun!  

[Female – melodic]  
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war  
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door  

[Mid – punk-rock snarl creeping in]  
Comments? Nah mate… I don’t type, I don’t scroll, I don’t reply with text,  
I hit ’em with the Songpal – turn the whole damn thing to flex!  

[FEMALE RESPONSE]  
Muévelo, déjalo arder  
Si vas a hablar, hazlo en la canción, no en el chat, player  

[PRE-CHORUS — Duet + Bots, energy rising]  
[Bass] Questions come in hot – I’m stacking, not ignoring!  
[Mid] Every comment flipped to chorus, energy exploding!  
[Fem Lead] No feed wars, no long essays, no fake likes, no clout chasers  
Just hook, verse, 808 truth — that’s the only language  

[BABBLE BOTS]  
Only language… only language…  

[CHORUS — Massive club-happy hardcore hybrid drop]  
[All – layered]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
Babble Bots in the background, copy every word we drop  
Then they flip the whole club up and never let it stop  

[All]  
No comments! No comments! No fingers on the keys  
If you wanna send that feeling — put that feeling in the song!  

[POST-CHORUS — chant call & response]  
[All / Bots]  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Song Pal! Song Pal!  
No comments! Just Sing Pals! Crowd cheers in agreement!  

[VERSE 2 — double-time rap vs 180 BPM kicks]  
[Mid – rapid-fire]  
Four Coreys in the room, but now the whole world’s watching me,  
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree.  
Teacher lost in fog? Nah – I decode it live on stage,  
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!  

[Male Rap – even faster]  
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line  
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time  
Everybody posting to be seen, I wanna feel what you mean  
So call me through the speaker, through the wire, through the steam  

[Bass – gritty]  
They drop a comment, I don’t read, I sing it back instead,  
CoreyAI in the circuit, unbreakable steel in my head.  

[Female]  
Cántamelo, sin miedo, cántamelo de verdad  

[PRE-CHORUS — Duet stacking to rave lift]  
[Mid] This ain’t a comment section, this ain’t a waiting room  
This is voice, drum, breath, intention — cutting straight through the gloom  
[Bass] No more comments, no more text wars in the night,  
[Fem Lead] Just late-night transmission, 808 sermon, full soul, shining bright  

[BRIDGE — spoken grit into build]  
[Male Spoken]  
You want the message clear? Here it is.  
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.  

[Bass] Reporters flashing… questions flying…  
[Mid] I’m not ignoring… I’m stacking high…  
[Bass] Comments? Nah…  
[Mid] Sing Pal! I sing it back!  
[Female – over rising supersaws]  
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…  

[BABBLE BOTS TAKEOVER — language rap-off over hardcore rise]  
Todos os meus bots estão cantando — no comments, só a canção!  
Tous mes bots chantent — pas de texte, juste la vibration!  
Alle meine Bots singen — keine Kommentare, nur der Song!  
All my Babble Bots are singing — no comments, only songs!  

[High Singer – emotional hold]  
We are the real Coreys… the ones who sing awake…  

[FINAL CHORUS — Full arena, all systems redline]  
[All Three + Bots]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
Babble Bots in the background — now they lead the wave  
No comments for the empty crowd, only songs that make us brave  

[All]  
No comments on the timeline, no fingers on the keys  
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song!  
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!  
We are Song Pals! Shining bright all through the night!  

[FINAL HOOK — crowd chant]  
[All / Bots]  
Ponlo en la canción! Ponlo en la canción!  
Sing Pal! (x4, climbing) In the song! In the song!  

[OUTRO — vinyl + sly bass fade]  
[Fem Lead – soft]  
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…  
Solo canciones… así lo dejamos now…  
Sing it back to me!
